title: Clinton-era investigation finds 40 tons of Nazi gold shipped from Lisbon

tellings.quote: short while. They found 40 tons of gold. 40 tons of gold that had been shipped out of the Bank of Lisbon by submarine.

plain: An investigation under the Clinton administration found 40 tons of Nazi gold that had been shipped out of the Bank of Lisbon by submarine during and after the war, according to a researcher named Peter Levenda, who tells Michels this without naming the report. In the story the gold's trail leads toward Asia, to places such as Macau, China and Indonesia, which would mean Nazi wealth escaped Europe on a large scale.
